The **68-95-99.7 rule** (empirical rule) describes how data is distributed in a normal distribution:

- **≈ 68.27%** of values lie within **μ ± 1σ** (one standard deviation of the mean)
- **≈ 95.45%** lie within **μ ± 2σ**
- **≈ 99.73%** lie within **μ ± 3σ**

The visualization below draws the standard normal bell curve with three nested shaded bands. A slider lets you highlight each σ-level to see exactly how much of the distribution it captures.
